# AstriOrb

> AstriOrb Pvt. Ltd. is an independent software and hardware product engineering company founded in 2025 by Mohammed Hashim in Kerala, India. AstriOrb builds high-impact proprietary software products and smart hardware innovations across finance, culinary discovery, healthcare, productivity, and smart wearables.

For the exhaustive single-file context dossier for LLMs, RAG, and AI agents, see [llms-full.txt](https://astriorb.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Pages
- [Products](https://astriorb.com/products): AstriOrb portfolio of 5 product nodes (FISCLOK, Tastory, DocCo, Continuum, Project ROW).
- [About](https://astriorb.com/about): Founding story, leadership pedigree, and 100% in-house IP engineering model.
- [Careers](https://astriorb.com/careers): Autonomous engineering squad, culture pillars, and open roles in mobile, web, and hardware.
- [Contact](https://astriorb.com/contact): Direct investor relations (Tastory seed round) and clinical/hardware partnership channels.
- [Blog](https://astriorb.com/blog): Technical dispatches, engineering architecture logs, and founder dispatches.

## Product Nodes
- [FISCLOK](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.astriorb.fincend): Zero-knowledge encrypted personal finance manager for Android (v1.0.2 on Google Play Store).
- [Project Tastory](https://astriorb.com/products): Flagship intelligent culinary discovery and taste-matching platform (Flutter / Firebase).
- [Project DocCo](https://astriorb.com/products): Clinical workflow and medical records suite (HIPAA/GDPR aligned).
- [Project Continuum](https://astriorb.com/products): Offline-first project orchestration suite with reactive CRDT synchronization.
- [Project ROW](https://astriorb.com/products): Smart posture wearable device and companion mobile telemetry app with ESP32 BLE.

## Leadership
- **Mohammed Hashim**: Founder & Lead Architect. Computer Science Engineer, former Studio Head at Custodian Games Pvt. Ltd., Creative Consultant at Hopz Corp Pvt. Ltd., and AI engineer with industry tenure at Annolive (Bangalore).
